name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries may use brute-force techniques to attempt access to accounts when passwords are unknown.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries may use credentials of existing accounts to gain initial access.

name: Remote Services
description: Adversaries may use valid credentials to log into remote services.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an existing C2 channel.

name: Phishing
description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain initial access.
